aggregate_limit_caveat: The fixed one-hour Slurm cap is below nine worst-case 900-second invocations; termination preserves the completed prefix and leaves the tail undispatched. No automatic retries, restart, limit escalation or duplicate jobs.
coverage_policy: Native pass of staged but omitted child is a coverage failure, never full-workspace success. Exact native inventories and named well-formedness units must be compared to the reviewed references; no guessed correctness unit names.
scope: Nine distinct frozen UInt/raw-byte-frame controls; no completed positives rerun.
unproved_parent_policy: Require actual parent failure; report actual child outcome without presupposing pass. A locally passing child never masks an unproved parent.
